title: Market Regime-Based Multi-Asset Portfolio Optimization Using Nested Clustered Optimization for Tactical Asset Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27751v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a regime-aware tactical asset allocation (TAA) framework integrating market regime detection with Nested Clustered Optimization (NCO) for multi-asset portfolio construction. The central hypothesis is that incorporating market regime information into the NCO pipeline, specifically at the stages of covariance estimation, hierarchical clustering, and weight optimization, yields portfolios with improved risk-adjusted performance and reduced downside risk relative to regime-agnostic baselines. Market regimes (Bullish, Sideways/Neutral, Bearish) are detected using a Gaussian Hidden Markov Model (HMM) fitted exclusively on information available up to each decision point, thereby preventing look-ahead bias. Regime-conditional covariance matrices and clustering structures parameterize NCO at each rebalancing event. translated_title: 基于市场状态的多资产组合优化：利用嵌套聚类优化进行战术资产配置
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种状态感知的战术资产配置（TAA）框架，将市场状态检测与嵌套聚类优化（NCO）相结合，用于多资产组合构建。核心假设是：将市场状态信息融入NCO流程——特别是在协方差估计、层次聚类和权重优化阶段——相对于不感知状态的基准方法，能够产生具有更优风险调整后表现和更低下行风险的投资组合。市场状态（牛市、震荡/中性、熊市）使用高斯隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）进行检测，该模型仅基于每个决策点之前可获取的信息进行拟合，从而避免前视偏差。在每次再平衡事件中，状态条件协方差矩阵和聚类结构为NCO提供参数。一种由状态转换或最优权重重大变化触发的自适应再平衡规则，取代了固定日历……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种将基于高斯隐马尔可夫模型的市场状态检测与嵌套聚类优化（NCO）相结合的状态感知战术资产配置框架，通过在协方差估计、层次聚类和权重优化各阶段融入市场状态信息，实现更优的风险调整后表现和更低的下行风险。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a regime-aware tactical asset allocation framework that integrates Gaussian HMM-based market regime detection with Nested Clustered Optimization, embedding regime information into covariance estimation, hierarchical clustering, and weight optimization to achieve improved risk-adjusted performance and reduced downside risk.
